project_type: Monorepo: backend/ Fastify 5 + @fastify/websocket + Postgres (live rooms stored as JSON in public.live_room_snapshots), frontend/ Next.js 16 (App Router, client components, zustand stores)
language: TypeScript (backend ESM with .js import suffixes, zod 3)
build_system: backend: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json; frontend: next build. frontend AGENTS.md says Next.js has breaking changes: read frontend/node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing Next code.
test_framework: backend: vitest (backend/tests/*.test.ts, fixtures backend/tests/fixtures/fc26, helper pattern in tests/retention.test.ts: new MemoryFc26Catalog(resolveFc26Config({FC26_DATA_DIR})) + buildApp with StaticTokenAuthService). frontend: headless Playwright scripts frontend/tests/*.mjs using bundleEntry/openPage from tests/ui-harness.mjs (see tests/ongoing-auctions-ui.mjs); run with node.
build_command: cd backend; npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noEmit  |  cd frontend; npx next build
test_command: cd backend; npx vitest run  |  cd frontend; npm run typecheck (= node tests/type-boundary.mjs); node tests/restore-ui.mjs
verification_instructions: Backend: tsc --noEmit then vitest (known baseline: 6 skip-vote failures + load-only timeouts in cups/seasons/manager-mode/host-reports; report any NEW failure). Frontend: npm run typecheck, npx next build, node tests/restore-ui.mjs plus the existing node tests/*.mjs that touch files you edited. Scan changed files for invalid UTF-8 (write all files as UTF-8; accented names such as Koundé, Çalhanoğlu, Ødegaard, Sørloth).
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell. No long-lived dev servers. Do NOT apply migrations or touch the hosted DB. Two other workflows edit the same checkout (Part 9 live add-players: room.manager.ts, auction.engine.ts, hub/WS protocol, auction components/store, room-state poolAdditions; and fix-429/room-not-found: recommendation route, rate limiter, api error handling, reconnect sync). Re-read a file immediately before editing, make minimal targeted edits, never revert or reformat their changes, check git status/HEAD before each FEAT. Commit only your own files with git add <paths>; never push; never git add -A.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing conventions; no unrequested refactors. Host-only actions check requireHost; all inputs zod-validated server-side; client-supplied prices/pool never trusted (base prices recomputed with fc26BasePriceUnits). Restore data lives on Room (not in the strict settings schema).
key_patterns: RoomManager.mutate(code, (draft, events)=>...) is the only way to change a room (lock + sequence + persist + publish). Retention finalize (backend/src/modules/retention/retention.service.ts finalizeRetentions) is the pattern for adding SOLD players + purchases + team.playerIds in the LOBBY; START_AUCTION in auction.engine.ts keeps SOLD players and filters them out of the FC26 pool. Errors: requireThat(cond, CODE, message, status). Money: Cr values in multiples of 0.5, internal units = toUnits(cr) (x2) in backend/src/domain/money.ts. FC26 catalog: modules/fc26/fc26.catalog.ts list()/get()/search(). Default pool CSV loader/parseCsv: modules/players/player.service.ts.
directory_structure: backend/src/{app.ts,domain,schemas,repositories,realtime,modules/{auction,rooms,retention,fc26,players,teams,manager-mode,results}}, backend/data/{default-pool,...}, backend/tests; frontend/src/{app,components,services,stores,types,lib}, frontend/tests; supabase/migrations (not needed); FC26 CSVs at repo root.
